purpose: Separate human-facing visual QA from technical artifact validation for Book Factory production.

surfaces.minimum_proof: three distinct concepts plus thumbnail comparison
surfaces.acceptance: human selects a direction or rejects all

surfaces.minimum_proof: full-book contact sheet plus full-size title, copyright, paginated TOC, every chapter opener, representative body and all notes surfaces
surfaces.acceptance: human reviews the complete page rhythm and approves the profile before full production reuse

surfaces.minimum_proof: visual artifact with source, data date, and provenance
surfaces.acceptance: visual explains something better than prose and is not decorative filler

surfaces.minimum_proof: EPUB/Kindle route without duplicate front matter and with navigable TOC

failure_conditions: reader-facing proof labels or placeholder identity
manual page patches required to make proof acceptable
generic diagram with no explanatory payoff
text overflow, broken encoding, or unresolved source markers
blank or nearly empty accidental page
heading hyphenation or excessive body hyphenation
reader-facing internal provenance or local path
print page numbers or running heads in Kindle source
